graham.brief:
Barkley played a fraction of the Philadelphia snaps he'd been playing, and no report explains it. Saquon Barkley played 71% of the snaps in week 1 and 16% in week 2. The books have Barkley at 17.5 rush attempts, well above the 9.5 he's averaging. One Philadelphia week is one week.

Chicago's pass defense gives up yards through the air, 9th-worst in the league. Chicago is the 9th-most run-first offense in football, running more than the situation calls for.

Chicago gets clean runs before contact, and Philadelphia keeps playing light in the box. Tyson Bagent is a backup who's played 14% of the snaps.

The total has slipped from 44 to 41.5 during the week. Philadelphia is favored by 3.5, and the books look for about 22.5 points from them. Hurts' attempts line opened 29.5 and is 28.5 now.

Nobody in Philadelphia has said whether Barkley's drop in snaps was a choice. If Chicago runs over the first two series at the season rate, nothing here has changed.
